Using the supplied USNO response for 2025-06-21 at coordinates 38.9072,-77.0369, report geometry.coordinates; day, month, year, and day_of_week; tz and isdst; curphase and fracillum; every field in closestphase; and every phen/time pair in moondata and sundata in returned order.

Stopping condition: Stop after the location, date, timezone/DST values, lunar phase details, closest phase, and all returned Moon and Sun events have been recorded.

Constraints:
- Use only the supplied USNO response.
- Preserve geometry coordinate order and every event array's returned order.
- Keep moondata and sundata separate.
- Do not convert times, infer a local timezone, or add events not returned by the response.
